<!--
  The frame of a signed-in app with a first screen in it. Axes: layout (sidebar: navigation on the left, top: a
  bar above the content, panes: a narrow navigation, a list and a detail), density. The collapse of the sidebar
  is a port contract.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { AppNav, AppUser } from "./app-shell.types";
  import type { NavLink, NavSearch } from "./nav-bar.types";
  import type { Metric } from "./metric-row.types";
  import type { Point } from "./chart-panel.types";
  import type { Event } from "./activity-feed.types";
  import type { OverviewChart, OverviewActivity } from "./dashboard-overview.types";

  export type AppShellProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    nav: AppNav;
    user: AppUser;
    search: NavSearch;
    metrics: Metric[];
    chart: OverviewChart;
    activity: OverviewActivity;
    layout?: "sidebar" | "top" | "panes";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../primitives/block/block.svelte";
  import Container from "../primitives/container/container.svelte";
  import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.svelte";
  import List from "../primitives/list/list.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import AppMain from "../components/app-main.svelte";
  import NavBar from "../blocks/nav-bar.svelte";
  import Panel from "../components/panel.svelte";
  import SidebarNav from "../blocks/sidebar-nav.svelte";
  import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    nav,
    user,
    search,
    metrics,
    chart,
    activity,
    layout = "sidebar",
    density = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: AppShellProps = $props();
</script>

<Block
  tag="section"
  class="bg-background"
  aria-labelledby={(landmarkLabel ? undefined : tpl("{0}-title", id))}
  data-testid="app-shell"
  data-layout={layout}
  aria-label={landmarkLabel}
>
  {#if ((layout as string) === "top")}
    <Stack gap="6" align="stretch">
      <NavBar
        label={nav.label}
        brand={nav.brand}
        links={nav.links}
        current={nav.current}
        search={search}
        actions={{ mode: "none" }}
        layout="search"
        landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}
      />
      <Container class={cn("mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4", "pb-8")} data-slot="container">
        <AppMain id={id} title={title} metrics={metrics} chart={chart} cols="1-4" activity={activity} density={density} />
      </Container>
    </Stack>
  {:else}
    <Container class={cn("mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4", "py-8")} data-slot="container">
      {#if ((layout as string) === "sidebar")}
        <Grid cols="1" class="items-start gap-6 md:grid-cols-[16rem_minmax(0,1fr)]">
          <SidebarNav
            label={nav.label}
            brand={nav.brand}
            links={nav.links}
            current={nav.current}
            userName={user.name}
            userEmail={user.email}
            density={density}
            landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}
          />
          <AppMain id={id} title={title} metrics={metrics} chart={chart} activity={activity} density={density} />
        </Grid>
      {:else}
        <Grid cols="1-3" class="items-start gap-4">
          <SidebarNav
            label={nav.label}
            brand={nav.brand}
            links={nav.links}
            current={nav.current}
            userName={user.name}
            userEmail={user.email}
            width="compact"
            density={density}
            landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}
          />
          <Panel title={activity.title} description={activity.text} id={tpl("{0}-list", id)}>
            <List class="m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-4 p-0" data-testid="items">
              {#each activity.events as e (e.id)}
                <ListItem class="flex flex-col gap-2" data-testid="item">
                  <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
                    {e.title}
                  </Text>
                  <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
                    {e.time}
                  </Text>
                </ListItem>
              {/each}
            </List>
          </Panel>
          <AppMain id={id} title={title} metrics={metrics} chart={chart} density="compact" />
        </Grid>
      {/if}
    </Container>
  {/if}
</Block>
